parts.role: USB-MIDI uses the onboard USB connector; requires C/C++ firmware.
Dedicated 5V input from USB AC adapter. Data pins NC. CC1/CC2 each have separate 5.1k Rd. Rear 7-pin header plus two 2-pin VBUS/GND support headers. Mouth toward bottom edge; no PD negotiation.
Automatic startup: ON=VIN. CT=10nF/25V or higher, about 26.6ms typical 10-90% at 5V. QOD disabled. Slew control only; not a current limiter, reverse-current or overvoltage protector.

On-board TRS: maker terminal 2=RING 3=SLEEVE 4=TIP (two physical legs). No terminal 1: maker item 1 is the housing. Mouth toward bottom edge; line output only.
